newsitem.title: KENYA: 16 Kenyans said killed by cattle rustlers.
newsitem.headline: 16 Kenyans said killed by cattle rustlers.

text.p: Sixteen ethnic Pokot villagers were killed by cattle rustlers in northwestern Kenya on Sunday, a Nairobi newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The East African Standard said at least 200 bandits attacked villagers near the town of Kapenguria, shot dead the 16 Pokots and stole 1,500 cattle, goats and sheep.
The Daily Nation newspaper said on Monday at least 51 Kenyan Pokots, who had fled Kenya, were killed by Karamojong cattle rustlers near the northeastern Ugandan market centre of Amdat on Wednesday.

In Kampala, the government-owned New Vision newspaper said on Monday at least 76 Pokot villagers were killed in northeastern Uganda on Wednesday by cattle rustlers from the Matheniko Karamojong and Turkana of Kenya.
Cattle rustling is common in northern Kenya and Uganda.
